atlas_research_hypothesis.query: Formulate an empirical multi-timeframe trading hypothesis for XAUUSD (RANGE_SPECIALIST). Observed microstructure physics: personality=STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING, wick_to_body=3.009, trend_persistence=0.267, mean_reversion=0.733. Learned timeframe weights: D1 (w=+0.211), M30 (w=+0.207), H4 (w=+0.199). Ablation-retained features: liquidity_sweep (w=+0.441), rsi_momentum (w=+0.125), bos_breakout (w=+0.123), fvg_impulse (w=+0.120) (pruned/left out by ablation: none).
atlas_research_hypothesis.hypothesis_statement: Atlas & Forge empirical synthesis for XAUUSD (RANGE_SPECIALIST): Data shows STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING microstructure (wick/body=3.009, mean-reversion=0.733). Multi-timeframe return regression assigns highest predictive weight to D1 (w=+0.211), M30 (w=+0.207), H4 (w=+0.199). Controlled leave-one-out ablation retained [liquidity_sweep (w=+0.441), rsi_momentum (w=+0.125), bos_breakout (w=+0.123), fvg_impulse (w=+0.120)] and pruned [none].
